'''Perks'''
---- {{Unreleased}}
'''Perk''' were a feature which allowed the player to apply enhancements to towers; these enhancements would boost the effectiveness of towers in various ways, such as increasing damage inflicted by towers or applying debuffs to them. Only a menu for them was implemented into the game in [[Hardcore Testing BETA]], but it was later removed in the [[v1.0.0|Solar Eclipse Update]]. This feature has been confirmed to be scrapped[[File:Screenshot 2026-03-08 at 09.31.28.png|280px]]
[[File:Screenshot 2026-03-08 at 09.31.14.png|450px]]
https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/587355301674614854/1228373734901940296 (Tower Defense Simulator Discord Server) due to it creating balancing issues and it making support towers obsolete. The [[Skills]] feature can, however, be considered the replacement for '''Perks'''. ----
==Obtainment Method== [[File:TDS Crate Animations + Mystery Box|150px|thumb|Tier II Perk Crate animation]] '''Perks''' would be mainly obtained from crates, however, it is not known how exactly the crates would be obtained. There were three crates that gave '''Perks''', all of which tiered, starting from tier I up to tier III. As there are also three tiers of '''Perks''', it is likely each tiered crate gave perks of equivalent tier. They would be opened similar to crates, where they would drop from the sky into the crate room and then be opened, showing the obtained '''Perk'''. {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:PerkICrate.png|175px]] |[[File:PerkIICrate.png|175px]] |[[File:PerkIIICrate.png|175px]] |- |Tier I Perk Crate |Tier II Perk Crate |Tier III Perk Crate |} ==Usage== [[File:Molten Shot Early Version|200px|thumb|Early version of the ''Molten Shot'' '''Perk''']] '''Perks''' could be applied to towers in a menu of the inventory. While this menu was added to the game in [[Hardcore Testing BETA]], it did not function at all. As the '''Perks''' list towers next to their name, it is highly likely each '''Perk''' could only be applied to one tower at a time, which would be displayed on the '''Perk'''. The alternative is that each '''Perk''' obtained would be already tied to one of the towers, with the player only being able to pick which one they want to have applied. Each '''Perk''' has a number next to its name, that being its tier. It is highly likely that each tier comes from the identically tiered perk crate, meaning that for example tier III perks come from the Tier III Perk Crate. It also suggests that each perk could have multiple tiers. ===Available Perks=== [[File:Static-assets-upload8132277931307274349.webp|200px|thumb|'''Perks''' Menu]] As the '''Perks''' menu was added to the game, it was possible to see some of the '''Perks''' which were planned, however, it was not possible to see their descriptions or how they work. The only exception is ''Molten Shot'', which had its description listed and the developers have even posted footage of a similar '''Perk''', which is likely an early version of ''Molten Shot''. These are all the '''Perks''' which could be seen in-game: {{Clear}} {| class="empty-table pad-5" style="min-width:750px; text-align:center; margin:0 auto" | class="align-center" |[[File:FireballSkill.png|150px]]
{{Color|MoltenMode|Molten Shot I}} |Small chance to ignite enemies on fire on hit. Was applied to the [[Soldier]]. |- | class="align-center" |[[File:Transparent.png|150px]]
{{Color|Frost|Frost Shot II}} |Small chance to freeze enemies on hit. Was applied to the [[Minigunner]]. |- | class="align-center" |[[File:Transparent.png|150px]]
{{Color|Golden|Haste III}} |Boosts the firerate of the tower. Was applied to the [[Freezer]]. |} ==Trivia== *The style of the '''Perks''' was based on icons used for skills from ''Ashea: Reborn'', an old Roblox game. One of the icons, that being ''Molten Shot'', even reuses the icon for the Fireball skill from said game. **The icons were made by [https://www.tumblr.com/likeclockwork7 Eris] around 2015. **This is not the first time a game made by BelowNatural would use these icons, as the same icons were used for an unreleased [[bark woof]] dungeon crawler. ***Therefore, they were most likely first taken from ''Ashea: Reborn'' for the dungeon crawler, then taken from the dungeon crawler to Tower Defense Simulator, similarly to how assets from BelowNatural's other projects would be reused in Tower Defense Simulator, like weapon models from ''R2DA'' being used by towers in the game. **This is not the first time they were actually used in Tower Defense Simulator, as the [[Medic]]'s ''Cleansing'' ability actually uses the icon for the Heal spell from the same game. **A few icons, which did not originate from that game, also exist, suggesting icons stylized based on ''Ashea: Reborn'' skills were made, either by Tower Defense Simulator developers or taken from some other game. As it is likely they may have been considered to be used at one point, all known icons will be listed below: StabSkill.png|''Stab'' Skill KnifeThrowSkill.png|''Knife Throw'' Skill SlashSkill.png|''Slash'' Skill TauntSkill.png|''Taunt'' Skill RejuvenateSkill.png|''Rejuvenate'' Skill HeavySwingSkill.png|''Heavy Swing'' Skill DrainSkill.png|''Drain'' Skill Medic Ability.png|''Heal'' Skill UnknownElectricPerk.png|Unknown Electric Icon ==Notes== {{BrowseNavBox}} __NOTOC__ [[Category:Features]]
